title: A trianoni békeszerződés (1920. június 4.) (What Trianon Changed)
grammar: Causal-Consequence Discourse, Treaty Formulations & Transnational Identity Register

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say when and where the Treaty of Trianon was signed and what it changed.
I can say why the delegates signed, using azért, hogy.
I can use the words for the signing, the detachment of territory and the new borders.
I can read a short account of 4 June 1920 and answer questions about it.
